item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: climate change — Carbon dioxide (CO₂) has been the poster child of climate change, but another culprit could be flying just under the radar. Fortunately, methane remains in the atmosphere for only about a decade, and reducing its emissions could provide rapid climate mitigation effects.
